entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I assist you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I'm... I'm a bit confused. I ordered a jersey and I think I need to return it. The website was a little overwhelming.
I can certainly help you look into a return. Do you have your order number handy?
I think so... yes, it's VF-8675-309. I just don't know if I'm still able to. I've had it for a little bit.
Thank you, I'm pulling up that order now. I see the Aero Race Jersey. So I can best help you, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference, I guess? I think I just got the wrong size. It's really too tight across the chest. I was hoping I could exchange it, but I couldn't figure out the process. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help with that. Let me just check the delivery date and review the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I see the jersey was delivered 36 days ago. Our standard return policy allows for returns and exchanges up to 90 days from delivery, so you are well within the window.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's a huge relief. So I can definitely do an exchange?

Yes, absolutely. Since you'd just like to get a larger size, I can process that exchange for you right now. I will email you a prepaid shipping label to send back the original jersey. As soon as it's scanned by the carrier, we'll ship out the new one to you. Does that sound good?
That sounds perfect! Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so much less confusing.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that label to the email on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
